failure_modes.description: Trading process crashes after writing local pending-submit intent to WAL but before recording broker acknowledgement.
failure_modes.detection: Startup recovery discovers orders in PENDING_SUBMIT or UNKNOWN state without terminal ack/reject.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Mark order UNKNOWN, query broker by client_order_id/idempotency_key during reconciliation, converge to broker state without duplicating order submission.

failure_modes.description: Event replay or redelivered broker/feed messages emit duplicate order intents or duplicate execution fills.
failure_modes.detection: Event ID, fill ID, or idempotency key already present in durable deduplication registry.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Idempotently ignore duplicates, preserve exact order intent and ledger balance, record duplicate counter metric.

failure_modes.description: Primary datastore is lost and must be restored from an earlier verified checkpoint backup plus subsequent WAL archive segments.
failure_modes.detection: Datastore unavailable or fresh standby provisioned from backup archive.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Verify backup manifest SHA-256, restore base snapshot, replay WAL tail, reconcile with broker, verify zero balance/position drift before enabling trading.

failure_modes.description: Active node loses network connectivity to coordinator/broker and cannot renew its lease or verify external order state.
failure_modes.detection: Lease renewal fails or broker heartbeat/query times out.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Immediately fence local execution gate (block new orders), wait for connectivity and broker reconciliation before any resumption.

failure_modes.description: Stale primary continues attempting to submit orders after standby promoted with a higher fencing epoch.
failure_modes.detection: Monotonic fencing token check rejects stale epoch at execution gate and broker/coordinator boundary.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Reject all writes and order submissions from stale epoch; only active holder of highest valid lease may proceed after reconciliation.

failure_modes.description: Recovered node loads an outdated checkpoint or market-data snapshot exceeding configured freshness threshold.
failure_modes.detection: Snapshot or feed availability timestamp age exceeds max_snapshot_age_ms / max_market_feed_age_ms.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Block order submission (fail-closed) until fresh verified snapshot and live feed timestamps are observed.

failure_modes.description: Backup snapshot payload or WAL archive record is tampered with or corrupted on disk/object store.
failure_modes.detection: SHA-256 payload digest mismatch or WAL hash-chain break during restore.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Abort restore immediately, refuse to start trading, emit structured corruption error and require operator escalation / prior clean backup.

failure_modes.description: External broker API is unreachable during startup reconciliation, leaving external open orders and balances unverified.
failure_modes.detection: Broker reconciliation snapshot/order query returns connectivity or timeout error.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Keep execution gate locked (fail-closed) with UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE reason until broker connectivity recovers and reconciliation succeeds.
